activity.notes: Kubrat is the historical ruler associated with the formation of Old Great Bulgaria/Onogur-Bulgar confederation in the seventh century. Scholarly reconstructions vary over the exact foundation and death dates, with c.632-635 for formation and c.650-668 for the end of his rule, so ATLAS stores a representative c.632-c.665 reign rather than false precision.

sources.title: Old Great Bulgaria and the Rise of the Onoğurs during the Rule of Kubrat
sources.citation_text: The academic article treats Old Great Bulgaria as a seventh-century polity founded and ruled by Khan Kubrat.

sources.title: Kubrat
sources.citation_text: The historical summary gives Kubrat as the founding khan of Old Great Bulgaria and notes competing chronologies for his reign and death.
